title: Inconsistent CORS matching due to incorrect handling of '+' in URL path by unquote_plus function
trigger_payload:
GET /api/super+Secret HTTP/1.1
Host: {BASE_URL}
Origin: https://evil.com
Connection: close
oracle: Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is set to https://evil.com instead of being restricted to https://onlythis.com, allowing unauthorized cross-origin access
